study.question: Can removal of exactly redundant scorer input coordinates retain the current incumbent click AUC and lower measured prediction cost more effectively than a similar parameter reduction that removes nonlinear channels?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0072-scorer_first56 and g2-r0073-scorer_rescue_prefix56 both give click AUC0.6670890456047657 versus unchanged0.6675018907227037 (loss0.0004128451); second24 gives0.6653677985223699. g2-r0073-scorer_rescue_xavier56 gives0.6665819135356411 and suffix56 gives0.6665394809641785, so these bounded scale/subset changes did not rescue width56. These are reproducible same-seed outcomes, not independent seed evidence or a proof every channel is necessary. Earlier embedding/readout reductions, failed owner rank reductions, successful semantic partition and global summary contraction, and unsuccessful layout/weighted branches were reviewed. Source observation: the first scorer affine consumes[q,k,q-k,q*k,action]; the q-k coordinates are exactly linearly redundant over real arithmetic. Existing merged_hoist removes that arithmetic only during prediction, retaining redundant learned weights during training. Hypothesis: retain64/32 nonlinear channels and replace the redundant400-input first affine with304 inputs, preserving its initialized real-arithmetic function and function class. This may preserve utility better than width reduction. Plain and orthonormal quotient coordinates test sensitivity to parameterization. Smaller training interactions/affines and no derived weight merge in plain evaluation may lower cost; prediction benefit is unverified and likely modest because the incumbent already merges at evaluation. No optimization equivalence is assumed.

study.proposed_difference: Only Model.__init__, _interactions and _evaluation_activation change. After every inherited initialization/slice, plain coordinates store[A=Wq+Wd,B=Wk-Wd,Wp,Wa] and train on[q,k,q*k,a]. Orthogonal coordinates store[(Wq+Wk)/sqrt(2),(Wq-Wk+2Wd)/sqrt(6),Wp,Wa] and train on[(q+k)/sqrt(2),sqrt(3/2)*(q-k),q*k,a]. The discarded null axis(-1,1,1)/sqrt(3) has zero input. Both transformations retain all64/32 channels and bias/Dice state and consume no RNG. Plain evaluation reads effective weights directly; orthogonal evaluation reconstructs the effective q/k weights locally without cache. Width50 uses the inherited redundant inputs and prefix slices, including matching Dice/second-layer columns. Reference is byte-identical. All trainable tensors are actual smaller cloned storage. This removes nonidentifiable parameter coordinates, not predictive function-class capacity; it is an empirical utility/optimization contrast, not a novelty claim.

Prediction utility screen also requires at least1% lower model-only batch p50 latency versus contemporaneous reference, p95 no more than2% worse and total validation inference seconds no worse. Parameter or training-time reduction alone cannot satisfy the topic. If host permits matched timing repetitions, use median paired ratios over at least3 complete paired units; otherwise label speed preliminary. Do not compare cross-round timing as matched evidence.

falsifiers: Any invariant, mask, gradient-ownership or shared-initial-state check fails: reject implementation integrity, retain its charged receipt and diagnose before interpreting scientific utility.

Either quotient loses more than0.0002 click AUC or fails measured prediction-cost criteria: reject that implementation for this utility objective; a training-only saving or lower parameter count is insufficient.

Both coordinate systems fail while original reference reproduces: bound the hypothesis to these two parameterizations under this one-pass recipe. This does not establish that redundant inputs add expressivity; AdamW/clipping/BF16 geometry remains an explanation.

Width50 preserves AUC and cost as well as or better than quotient: special advantage of redundant-coordinate removal is unsupported. Near parameter matching is not exact training/inference FLOP matching.

Any apparent benefit disappears in admissible paired repetitions, or confidence bounds cross the preservation margin: utility remains unsupported/preliminary; do not claim a mechanism from best validation selection.
alternative_explanations: AdamW coordinate dependence, second-moment adaptation, inherited weight decay, changed dense gradient norm/clipping and altered effective update scale can change trajectories despite identical initial real functions. No custom optimizer, gradient multiplier or loss hook is introduced.

Plain and orthogonal retained parameter norms/correlations differ; original null coefficients can affect global clipping and optimizer state despite contributing no function. Orthogonal basis control does not equate AdamW to the redundant reference.
BF16 q-k rounding and first-affine GEMM/accumulation shapes change; initialization equality is mathematical, not bitwise or training equivalence. Orthogonal reconstruction adds rounding sites.

Runtime loading/GPU noise, small first-affine share, strided effective-weight views and per-call reconstruction can erase theoretical savings. Width50 has different nonlinear capacity and inference work despite similar parameter counts.

One selected seed, long adaptive validation search and the benchmark offline feedback semantics limit generalization; repeated unchanged runs are reproducibility/cost checks, not new scientific contrasts. No withheld outcomes are available.
